capabilities.title: Reset a simulated world
capabilities.summary: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.
capabilities.notes: A reset advances the device revision. For determinism kind 'seeded', seed_control='reset_required' means the seed MUST be supplied here.

capabilities.title: Advance a simulated world
capabilities.summary: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.
capabilities.notes: ticks counts fixed simulated timesteps (fidelity.timestep_ms). The receipt's state_hash_after is the state hash after the last tick.

capabilities.title: Read a simulated world state
capabilities.summary: Return the complete normative state of a simulated world together with its revision and canonical state hash.
capabilities.notes: Deprecated in 0.9: Duplicate of the protocol method mhs.resource.read. The class stays valid and callable for its deprecation window; new drivers use the protocol method.

capabilities.title: Take a world snapshot
capabilities.summary: Capture a restorable snapshot of the complete world state, including the revision and state hash, for deterministic restore later.
capabilities.notes: Deprecated in 0.9: Duplicate of the protocol method mhs.snapshot (Sim profile). The class stays valid and callable for its deprecation window; new drivers use the protocol method. Requires fidelity.snapshot_restore = true; otherwise MHS.MODE.SNAPSHOT_UNSUPPORTED.

capabilities.title: Restore a world snapshot
capabilities.summary: Restore the world to a previously captured snapshot, replacing the current state; the device revision advances and the state hash MUST equal the snapshot's.
capabilities.notes: Deprecated in 0.9: Duplicate of the protocol method mhs.restore (Sim profile). The class stays valid and callable for its deprecation window; new drivers use the protocol method. Only valid in simulated or replay mode and only when fidelity.snapshot_restore is true.

capabilities.title: Render a simulation frame
capabilities.summary: Render the current simulated world through a named camera and return an image artifact reference. Rendering does not advance simulated time.

capabilities.title: Set the world RNG seed
capabilities.summary: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.
capabilities.notes: Only meaningful when fidelity.determinism.seed_control is parameter or reset_required.

capabilities.title: Move joints to positions
capabilities.summary: Command one or more actuated joints to target positions in joint space, optionally over a declared duration, and report whether the target was reached within tolerance.

joint_positions.reason: joint travel limits are declared per binding

capabilities.notes: Position limits, velocity limits and joint-order conventions MUST be declared per binding in safety.envelope.

capabilities.title: Command joint velocities
capabilities.summary: Command continuous joint velocities for a bounded duration. The operation stops at the end of the duration or when cancelled.

joint_velocities.reason: velocity limits are declared per binding

capabilities.title: Command joint torques
capabilities.summary: Apply commanded joint torques for a bounded duration for compliant or force-controlled motion. Torque magnitude is bounded by the binding safety envelope.

joint_torques.reason: torque limits are declared per binding; exceeding them is MHS.SAFETY.ENVELOPE_VIOLATION

capabilities.title: Move to a Cartesian pose
capabilities.summary: Move the tool centre point to a Cartesian position and orientation in a named frame. The endpoint solves inverse kinematics; an unreachable target is rejected before motion.

position.reason: workspace bounds are declared per binding

capabilities.title: Command a Cartesian twist
capabilities.summary: Move with a commanded linear and angular velocity for a bounded duration, in a named frame.

linear.reason: speed limits are declared per binding

capabilities.title: Drive a mobile base
capabilities.summary: Drive a mobile base with a commanded linear and angular velocity for a bounded duration, or to a target pose. Obstacle and zone limits are enforced by the binding safety envelope.

linear_velocity.reason: maximum transit speed is declared per binding

angular_velocity.reason: maximum turn rate is declared per binding

capabilities.title: Stop motion safely
capabilities.summary: Stop all motion on the resource with a declared deceleration profile and report the stopping position. This capability is always cancellable=false and is exempt from rate limiting.
capabilities.notes: motion.stop is the declared safe-state achievement for many devices; endpoints MUST NOT rate-limit or permit-gate it.

capabilities.title: Home the axes
capabilities.summary: Drive axes to their declared home position or reference switch, establishing the coordinate reference needed by other motion capabilities.
capabilities.notes: Homing moves are motion; they are NOT a substitute for mhs.safety.reset and MUST be rejected while the device is latched.

capabilities.title: Engage the device emergency stop
capabilities.summary: Engage the device-level emergency stop: motion stops within the declared latency, outputs transition to the declared safe state, and the device latches until mhs.safety.reset.
capabilities.notes: Deprecated in 0.9: Duplicate of the protocol method mhs.safety.estop; endpoints route it to the same latch. The class stays valid and callable for its deprecation window; new drivers use the protocol method. motion.estop is the capability-level expression of mhs.safety.estop. Both MUST reach the same latch. MHS is never a safety-rated channel (MHS-000 6.3).

capabilities.title: Grasp an object
capabilities.summary: Close the gripper on a target object with a bounded force and report the achieved grasp width. A failed grasp is a completed operation with grasped=false, not a silent success.

force.reason: grasp force limit is declared per binding

capabilities.title: Release a grasped object
capabilities.summary: Open the gripper to release the held object, optionally to a declared opening width, and report the achieved width.

capabilities.title: Place an object at a target
capabilities.summary: Place the held object at a declared target location with an approach height, release the gripper and verify the object is no longer held.

capabilities.title: Pick an object from a source
capabilities.summary: Move to a declared source, grasp the object, lift it by a declared clearance and verify the grasp still holds. Combines cartesian motion and grasp under one receipt.

capabilities.title: Read a sensor
capabilities.summary: Read the current value of one or more sensor channels and return the values with a sampling timestamp and a monotone sequence number. Volatile channels are also available by subscription.

capabilities.title: Capture an image
capabilities.summary: Capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference.

capabilities.title: Capture a point cloud
capabilities.summary: Capture a depth point cloud over a declared range and return a point-cloud artifact reference with the point count and coordinate frame.

capabilities.title: Read a force/torque sensor
capabilities.summary: Read the current force and torque vector in a declared frame and return the wrench with its sampling timestamp.

capabilities.title: Read an IMU
capabilities.summary: Read linear acceleration, angular velocity and orientation from an inertial measurement unit, with the declared reference frame and timestamp.
capabilities.notes: Quaternion components are dimensionless (UCUM 1); the unit is carried here, not implied by convention.

capabilities.title: Aspirate liquid
capabilities.summary: Draw a specified volume of liquid from a declared labware well into a pipette tip, with a bounded flow rate and an optional liquid-level offset.

volume.reason: pipette tip capacity; bindings declare their actual range

capabilities.notes: Preconditions: tip attached, liquid present, labware loaded. Errors: MHS.DEVICE.PRECONDITION_UNMET with details.precondition.

capabilities.title: Dispense liquid
capabilities.summary: Dispense a specified volume from the pipette into a declared labware well, with optional blowout and mixing after dispense.

capabilities.title: Transfer liquid between wells
capabilities.summary: Aspirate a volume from a source well and dispense it into a target well as one receipted operation, so a failed transfer cannot leave an untracked half-state.

capabilities.title: Mix the contents of a well
capabilities.summary: Mix the contents of a declared well by repeated aspiration and dispense cycles at a bounded volume and speed.

speed.description: Mixing rate in aspirate/dispense cycles per minute.

capabilities.title: Wash a well or tip
capabilities.summary: Wash a declared well or the pipette tip with a bounded volume of wash solution, discarding waste to a declared waste container.

capabilities.title: Read a liquid level
capabilities.summary: Detect and report the liquid level and estimated volume in a declared container using a declared detection method.

capabilities.title: Move a sample or labware
capabilities.summary: Move a sample, plate or other labware object from one declared location to another using the device's transport mechanism.

capabilities.title: Incubate samples
capabilities.summary: Hold samples at a declared temperature, and optionally a declared atmosphere, for a declared duration. The achieved temperature and duration are reported in the output and receipt.

temperature.reason: incubator safe operating range; bindings narrow it

capabilities.title: Centrifuge samples
capabilities.summary: Spin declared samples at a target speed for a declared duration, optionally at a controlled temperature, then report the achieved speed and duration.

rpm.reason: rotor and sample balance limits are declared per binding

capabilities.notes: Cancellation is not offered while spinning: stopping a centrifuge mid-run is itself a hazard. Use mhs.safety.estop for emergency stops.

capabilities.title: Seal a plate
capabilities.summary: Apply a declared seal type to a microplate and report completion; the seal consumable is recorded as a consumable use.

capabilities.title: Unseal a plate
capabilities.summary: Remove the seal from a microplate so that the wells are accessible, reporting completion.

capabilities.title: Store samples
capabilities.summary: Place samples into a declared storage location at a declared temperature and record the storage location in the output so later retrieval is unambiguous.

capabilities.title: Capture a microscope image
capabilities.summary: Acquire a microscope image of the current field of view for a declared channel, exposure, binning and region of interest, returning an image artifact.

capabilities.title: Focus the microscope
capabilities.summary: Move the focus axis to a target Z position or run an autofocus search over a declared range, returning the achieved Z position and focus score.

capabilities.title: Set illumination
capabilities.summary: Set the illumination channel and intensity used for subsequent imaging or observation, with an optional bounded on-duration after which the light is turned off.

intensity.reason: emission power limits are declared per binding

capabilities.title: Set optical output power
capabilities.summary: Set the emitted optical power of a laser or light source to a declared setpoint, optionally ramping over a declared duration. Bindings for class 3B+ sources raise the risk class to R3.

power.reason: class-dependent maximum emission; the binding MUST narrow this

capabilities.notes: Requires a permit for R2 and above on hardware. The permit is bound to the exact input_digest.

capabilities.title: Open or close an optical shutter
capabilities.summary: Open or close a mechanical or electronic shutter in the optical path, reporting the resulting state and, for an open shutter, the open duration.
capabilities.notes: Closing a shutter is the declared safe state for optical sources; it MUST NOT require a permit.

capabilities.title: Align an optical element
capabilities.summary: Adjust an optical element along declared axes until a target coupling or position is reached, reporting the achieved offset and alignment quality.

capabilities.title: Measure voltage
capabilities.summary: Measure a DC or RMS voltage on a declared channel or terminal pair and return the value with its sampling timestamp and measurement range.

capabilities.title: Measure current
capabilities.summary: Measure current on a declared channel and return the value with its timestamp and range.

capabilities.title: Measure resistance
capabilities.summary: Measure resistance or impedance on a declared channel and return the value with its timestamp and excitation method.

capabilities.title: Acquire a spectrum
capabilities.summary: Acquire an optical or mass spectrum over a declared wavelength or mass range and return the axis and intensity arrays, or an artifact reference for large spectra.

wavelength_min.reason: detector range is declared per binding

capabilities.title: Measure intensity
capabilities.summary: Measure optical or radiant intensity at a declared wavelength or channel and return the value with its unit and integration time.

capabilities.title: Measure mass
capabilities.summary: Measure the mass on a balance or load cell and report the value and stability flag.

capabilities.title: Measure temperature
capabilities.summary: Measure temperature at a declared location and return the value with its timestamp and stability flag.

capabilities.title: Measure pressure
capabilities.summary: Measure absolute, gauge or differential pressure at a declared port and return the value with its reference and timestamp.

capabilities.title: Measure flow
capabilities.summary: Measure volumetric or mass flow at a declared line and optionally the accumulated volume since a declared instant.

capabilities.title: Set a thermal setpoint
capabilities.summary: Set the target temperature of a thermal zone and optionally wait for the zone to reach the setpoint within a declared tolerance.

target_temperature.reason: device thermal limits; bindings narrow them

capabilities.title: Drive a digital or analog output
capabilities.summary: Drive a general-purpose output pin to a declared digital or analog value, reporting the applied value. The pin's electrical limits are declared per binding.

capabilities.title: Set a valve position
capabilities.summary: Open, close or position a valve to a declared state, reporting the achieved position. The port routing map is declared per binding.

capabilities.title: Run a pump
capabilities.summary: Run a pump at a declared flow rate for a declared duration or volume in a declared direction, reporting the volume moved.

flow_rate.reason: pump and tubing limits are declared per binding

capabilities.title: Submit a bounded compute job
capabilities.summary: Run a bounded command-line computation on the device host with a declared timeout and return exit code and stdout/stderr artifact references. Always R1 or higher.
capabilities.notes: The endpoint MUST NOT accept shell metacharacter expansion; command is an argv vector. The binding MUST declare which executable allowlist applies.

capabilities.title: Cancel a compute job
capabilities.summary: Cancel a previously submitted compute job and report the signal used and whether the job terminated.
capabilities.notes: Deprecated in 0.9: Duplicate of the protocol method mhs.operations.cancel. The class stays valid and callable for its deprecation window; new drivers use the protocol method.

capabilities.title: Run a process recipe
capabilities.summary: Execute a named, versioned process recipe on a process controller with declared parameters and return the exit status and a report artifact.
capabilities.notes: The recipe is content-addressed: recipe_ref MUST resolve to an immutable document whose digest is recorded in the receipt.

capabilities.title: Describe the device
capabilities.summary: Return the device's generated profile, identity, mode, capability list and the digest of its manifest, so an agent can re-orient without re-discovering the endpoint.
capabilities.notes: Deprecated in 0.9: Duplicate of the protocol method mhs.devices.get (and the generated reference file). The class stays valid and callable for its deprecation window; new drivers use the protocol method. The manifest digest allows a host to detect that a device profile changed under it between sessions.

capabilities.title: Calibrate the device
capabilities.summary: Run the device's calibration procedure against a declared reference or standard and return a calibration artifact reference and validity window.

capabilities.title: Run a device self-test
capabilities.summary: Run the device's built-in self-test and return a pass/fail verdict with per-check results and a report artifact reference. Self-test does not certify safety.
capabilities.notes: A passing self-test is evidence about the device's own checks, not an MHS safety certification.

capabilities.title: Configure named device parameters
capabilities.summary: Write one or more named parameters of a resource (setpoints, ranges, modes, gains) as a partial patch and report what was applied. The binding's effective input schema is derived from the writable properties of the bound resource's state_schema.

applied.description: The parameters as applied, keyed like the patch (values after any device rounding).

capabilities.notes: Served by mhs.resource.write: a write is routed to the cap.device.configure.v1 binding of the target resource and its receipt carries this class id. The effective input schema of a binding is the set of state_schema properties that are not readOnly; each keeps its type, x-mhs-unit and bounds, and binding limits are keyed by state paths. A patch key outside the state schema fails with MHS.RESOURCE.FIELD_UNKNOWN; a readOnly key with MHS.RESOURCE.NOT_WRITABLE. resource_kinds '*' means any resource kind the device declares. The class floor is R1; a binding raises the risk to that of its most hazardous parameter.
